### Landman (2024) — The Cost of Power in a World Built on Oil 🛢️

Landman is a drama series starring Billy Bob Thornton as Tommy Norris, a tough and experienced crisis manager working in the oil fields of West Texas. Surrounded by powerful businessmen, dangerous workers, and unpredictable situations, Tommy operates in an industry where enormous profits come with equally enormous risks.

As the pressure intensifies, Tommy must navigate deadly accidents, criminal dealings, corporate conflicts, and complicated family responsibilities. Every problem demands a quick decision, but every choice can create new consequences. While powerful people chase bigger fortunes, Tommy struggles to keep everything under control in a business where mistakes can cost lives.

The series explores ambition, greed, loyalty, family, and the consequences of chasing wealth. It reveals how the pursuit of money can influence decisions, damage relationships, and force people to compromise their values just to stay ahead.

What makes Landman gripping is its realistic look at the dangerous relationship between money and power. Behind every successful deal lies a risk, and behind every fortune is a story of people fighting to protect what they have.

💬 “In a world driven by money, the real question is how much you're willing to risk to get it.”

source_details.synopsis: Landman is an American drama series created by Taylor Sheridan and Christian Wallace, inspired by the podcast series Boomtown hosted by Wallace. Starring Billy Bob Thornton as a landman for an oil company, the show premiered on November 17, 2024, on Paramount+. In March 2025, the series was renewed for a second season, which premiered on November 16, 2025. In December 2025, the series was renewed for a third season. Despite some elements igniting controversy, the series has been received positively by critics overall.
